description: Deterministic rule that decides whether a QA request is a specific instruction (run it as the plan) or unspecified (generate a test plan first). Implemented twice: src/crawler/qa_agent.py (authoritative, used when planning) and src/lambda/mcpServer/qaRun.mjs (hint returned by start_qa_run / continue_qa_run). Both load the word lists from this file and both test suites run every case below. Change the rule here, in both implementations, and in .claude/architecture.md together.
rule: 1. Empty or whitespace-only request -> unspecified (rule: empty).
2. Lowercase. Note whether a double-quoted, curly-quoted or backticked phrase of 2+ characters is present, then remove URLs and quoted phrases.
3. Words are matches of [a-z0-9]+('[a-z]+)? ; leftover = words not in generic_words.
4. No leftover and no quote -> unspecified (rule: generic).
5. A quote -> specific (rule: quoted). Else a leftover word in action_verbs -> specific (rule: action-verb). Else a word in test_verbs plus any leftover -> specific (rule: test-verb-object).
6. Otherwise -> unspecified with ambiguous=true and focus=leftover (rule: ambiguous). An optional model classifier may overrule only this case.
